lines: Decision needed from Brandon, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time (2026-11-27 12:00 America/Boise) and a run may not move its own end or make it again (refused twice, 03:21 and 03:30 UTC, the answer both times: schedule boundaries are user-only). He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread so that the root can do it from a turn that is his. The Partner put it to him at 8:32 PM MT and he skipped it for now; the Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

Chain 12 is read whole and on origin main (`26394c0a`), four merges: winter's glints second list, fall's air second list, summer's sand fourth list, the shutter's mend for frames that travel. On it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, engine `1ea036d88a7e37e5`; the whole vitest 65 files passed and 1 skipped, 908 tests passed and 4 skipped; "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.9539"; "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.7226 (threshold 0.75, detail.minSharpnessRatio)", still a failure; M4 0.9694, 0.9049, 0.9546, 0.9594 and M5 0.993, 1, 0.9653, 0.9997 for shakes 1 to 4, all pass; winter's two and spring's two draft stills the same bytes as before, summer's two and fall's two changed; triangles at high winter 1,490,555, spring 1,450,250, summer 1,759,834, fall 1,790,631 of 1,800,000; `node tools/miniatures.mjs` pass.

Chain 13 is being read on four more merges that are not on origin main yet (local `e391065f`, started 03:37 UTC): the table's dressing anchored to the planted foot (spring's petals, fall's leaves, winter's frost), the governor line of the live page's controls, fall's miniature third list, summer's base fourth list. Read so far: tsc exit 0, both makes exit 0, build exit 0, engine `92a0ba308c41405a`; "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.9537" (base 1.091, miniature 0.954); "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.7228 (threshold 0.75, detail.minSharpnessRatio)" (base 0.723, miniature 1.362); "pass M3 spring-rest: 0.7655" (base 0.766, miniature 0.861). Still to come: the change's M4 and M5, the eight stills, the counts, the whole vitest.

Picture 1 is summer at rest on chain 13's tree, approved left and build right. The base carries its fourth list: swirled relief, shells and sea glass in the approved's places, and its builder's fitted tones sit within 12 levels in all fourteen boxes (STATED). Below the bar and said plainly: the base still reads browner, greyer and grainier than the approved's smooth cream, measured by me on 36 px patches as low left flank 116,77,39 against the approved's 169,116,57 and right side 96,88,81 against 73,67,60, so the build has less contrast from the lit left to the shaded right; the shells are brown and glossy where the approved's are cream white and matte; the inside has a milky veil, a small dark cottage and a grey pond; the tree's seventh list is not in. A fifth list is with the base's builder: grain down at this distance, the low left flank's light, the right darker and warmer, shells and sea glass.

Picture 2 is fall at rest on chain 13's tree, approved left and build right. The miniature carries its third list: stone courses on the cottage, a board fence, a ridged trunk, litter on the ground. Below the bar: M3 fails on the base, whose third list is not in yet (its builder reads 0.7975 on its own machine, STATED, push by 04:20 UTC); the miniature's fine detail now reads 1.362 of the approved's, which is more than the approved has and so a warning of hard pale edges rather than a credit, ordered traced part by part; the leaves in the air are larger and flatter than the approved's, the bats are three and large where the approved shows two small ones, the purple window has six lights where the approved has four (leave given to mend it in the shared pane with the other three seasons' stills held byte for byte).

Picture 3 is the table's petals at 3840 by 2160, film frames 676 to 690 (winter into spring). Before, above: petals slide and turn over between two frames. With the mend, the lower rows: every petal holds its place and its turn from frame 679 on. Its builder counted 0 half turns over 300 petals in film frames 576 to 760 (STATED); the mend moves 622 pixels of spring's rest still and 2,811 of its landed still.

The change of season slips: its finisher's first whole draw of shake 1 under the new law showed the heart's fall from white to rose only about a fifth of the ball's radius wide with a smooth white disc in the middle and no strokes of the storm across it, where about half was asked. It is setting the lens off line against frames of all four seasons and draws again; shakes 1 and 2 are now promised for about 05:15 UTC instead of 03:50 and all four for about 07:15 (STATED). What it measured on shake 1: no step of the glass's mean over 4.4 levels a frame in frames 660 to 698, the base in sight in every frame, the pass from one base to the other over 6 frames. Rough draft 6 waits for shakes 1 and 2.

The page's carried state (a spring still drawn after other frames in one page differs by 12,864 pixels, at most 7 levels): traced so far to one twinkle value shared by the page in `src/miniature/trunk.ts` that winter, summer and fall write and spring reads without writing. Winter's film frame 3240 is byte equal as a first draw and after frames 3200 to 3239 (STATED), which does not cover spring; spring's proof is promised by 04:40 UTC. It decides whether the masters may be drawn in chunks (open item 251), so no master frame is drawn before it is settled.
The controls' governor line is merged in chain 13 with 10 new tests. Nobody has seen it on a real page at 60 frames a second; that stays not verified and goes on the walk of the published page.

15 agents are at work at 03:40 UTC: summer (tree, miniature, air, glass, sand, base), fall (miniature, base, air), spring (base), winter's glints, the change of season, the controls, the shutter, the table's dressing and the carried state.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: chain 12's eight draft stills; chain 13's three review stills so far. On helper machines: the builders' own stills and frames. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
